plainText:
Yoichi Nishijima (Japanese: 西嶋陽一 Nishijima Yōichi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Nishijima was born sometime on March 2 in , . He started working on the with , voicing Professor Amaranth.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
==== ====
Professor Amaranth

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Wonder White (The Wonderful 101)
Dokugozu (Project X Zone)
Alain (Golgo 13)
Egon Innkeeper (Claymore)
